tabs.$description: Stroke width of the rule under the tab list and of the underline under the active tab (BR-13). TBD-11: "thick" has no values; this follows a placeholder, not a brand value.

fg.$description: Label color of a tab that is not selected. TBD-05: the neutral scale is not defined; this follows a placeholder, not a brand value.

fgHover.$description: Label color of a tab that is not selected, while hovered. Draft: the hover color is not part of ADR-0028. TBD-04: the body text color is not decided; this follows a placeholder, not a brand value.

rule.$description: Color of the rule under the whole tab list. TBD-05: the neutral scale is not defined; this follows a placeholder, not a brand value.

fg.$description: Label color of the selected tab: brand pink on the black page, 8.37:1 (BR-01, ADR-0028).

indicator.$description: Color of the thick underline under the selected tab: brand pink (BR-01, ADR-0028). It is what keeps the selected tab from being told apart by color alone (WCAG 1.4.1).

color.$description: Focus ring color of a tab (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).

width.$description: Focus ring width of a tab (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).

offset.$description: Gap between a tab and its focus ring (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).

style.$description: Focus ring line style of a tab (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).
